title: Trip Protection Plans: Insurable Trip Cost, Trip Length and Latest Purchase
content:
Each Trip Protection plan insures a stay up to a set trip cost and a set trip length, and is sold up to a set point before check-in. On every plan the insured trip cost is the stay's total price, which must be insured in full.

## Acceptance limits by plan

| Plan | Insured trip cost | Highest insured trip cost (USD) | Longest stay covered (days) | Most active policies on one stay | Latest purchase (calendar days before check-in) | When the plan may be bought |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Cancellation Only | the stay's total price, insured in full | 10000.00 | 30 | 1 | 1 | at booking or before check-in |
| Trip Protection Essential | the stay's total price, insured in full | 15000.00 | 30 | 1 | 1 | at booking or before check-in |
| Trip Protection Standard | the stay's total price, insured in full | 25000.00 | 60 | 1 | 1 | at booking or before check-in |
| Trip Protection Plus | the stay's total price, insured in full | 50000.00 | 60 | 1 | 1 | at booking or before check-in |
| Trip Protection Premier | the stay's total price, insured in full | 75000.00 | 90 | 1 | 1 | at booking or before check-in |
| Trip Protection Premier CFAR | the stay's total price, insured in full | 75000.00 | 90 | 1 | 1 | within 14 days of booking, insuring the full stay total price |

## Column notes

- **Highest insured trip cost** is the highest trip cost the plan insures.
- **Longest stay covered** is the longest stay the plan covers, in days.
- **Most active policies on one stay** is one on every plan.
- **Latest purchase** is the latest point at which the plan may be bought, counted in calendar days before check-in; on every plan it is 1.

## Questions answered from the table

**Which plans cover a stay of more than 60 days?** Only Trip Protection Premier and Trip Protection Premier CFAR, whose longest covered stay is 90 days; Trip Protection Standard and Trip Protection Plus stop at 60 days, and Trip Cancellation Only and Trip Protection Essential at 30 days.

**Can a guest insure part of a stay's price on any plan?** No. On every plan the insured trip cost is the stay's total price, insured in full.

**Hypothetical: a stay whose total price is 18000.00 USD.** It is within the highest insured trip cost of Trip Protection Standard (25000.00), Trip Protection Plus, Trip Protection Premier and Trip Protection Premier CFAR, and above that of Trip Cancellation Only (10000.00) and Trip Protection Essential (15000.00).
